purpose: protocol-corrected nonhuman holdout measuring the retained v2.1+v1.2 configuration; surface-first gold with contract-derived IDs; not independent human gold

selection.population: processed papers excluding all 60 papers in dev12, cross-check12, holdout v3, holdout v4, and holdout v5
selection.eligibility: abstract length >= 300 and neutral extraction cue regex present: dataset|benchmark|corpus|evaluate|experiment|method|model|framework|task|propose|introduce (with inflections)
selection.prediction_blind_detail: selected and labelled from processed abstracts only; per-paper extractor caches and data/enriched predictions for these IDs were not read before the freeze (cache file existence/version metadata was checked only afterwards)

annotation.protocol_text: One entity per concept; surface = first fullest verbatim name span in the abstract (including parenthesized acronym when written). Include named methods/models/frameworks proposed, used, or compared; named datasets/benchmarks; conventional named tasks including explicitly listed pre-tasks. Exclude generic model families (e.g. large language models (LLMs)), generic nouns, metrics/scores, products, diseases, and paper-internal descriptive components. Relations follow mention-implies-link (paper-anchored edge per entity); METHOD_EVALUATED_ON only when the abstract explicitly evaluates a named method on a named dataset.
annotation.gold_id_derivation: src/enrichment/merge.py::_canonicalize_llm(surface, type, gazetteer v1.2, context=sentence containing the surface) — the same frozen function the hybrid pipeline applies to LLM surfaces. This slice measures extraction under the shared frozen normalization contract; it does not measure canonicalizer correctness itself.

decision_rule.role: protocol-corrected measurement of the retained configuration (no extractor change is gated here)
decision_rule.future_changes: any extractor/gazetteer change must be gated on a NEW untouched slice (v7) with this same surface-first protocol

limitations: Single nonhuman annotator; no inter-annotator agreement.
Selection is cue-enriched rather than a prevalence estimate for all 1,091 papers.
Annotation protocol v2 differs from v4/v5 (surface-first, contract-derived IDs); cross-slice deltas are measurement-protocol effects, not model improvements.
Gold IDs inherit the frozen canonicalizer contract; canonicalizer quirks (e.g. mixed-case acronyms) surface as system errors under that contract.
Useful as a leakage-separated diagnostic only; it cannot satisfy an independent-human gate.
